ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.7:0.3 ratio of low-intensity (dark grey/black) to high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity central regions on both lobes; high-intensity pixel clusters concentrated at the distal tips and scattered circular mottling across the primary dark surfaces.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an approximate interior angle of 40 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the trailing edge with pixel-amplitude peaks and valleys throughout the boundary length.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve trajectory originating from the median notch and sweeping upward towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density circular high-intensity clusters localized on the lateral lobe tips; numerous smaller circular clusters distributed across the dark ventral regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A prominent, straight, high-intensity linear mark approximately 10-15% of the fluke width on the left lobe, oriented diagonally.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on distal fluke tips and a distinct long diagonal scar on the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced textural irregularity on the extreme lateral edges due to dense barnacle clusters.
